title: Quietly Baked Dutch Fish Bake
description: A spicy and flaky Dutch dish featuring Thai sweet basil, baked to perfection in a fondue pot, without onion or garlic. This cozy dish is perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the cod fillets with salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper.
In a large bowl, mix together lemon juice, olive oil, and chopped Thai sweet basil.
Add the seasoned cod fillets to the bowl and marinate for 10 minutes.
Transfer the cod fillets to a fondue pot, reserving the marinade.
Pour the reserved marinade over the cod fillets in the fondue pot.
Sprinkle grated cheddar cheese over the top of the cod fillets.
Bake the cod fillets in the preheated oven for 12 minutes.
Remove the fondue pot from the oven and let it cool for 2 minutes.
Serve the Quietly Baked Dutch Fish Bake hot, garnished with additional Thai sweet basil if desired.
